name: flowagent
description: Visual AI workflow builder - drag nodes onto a canvas, run them as a live LangGraph, expose each workflow as an MCP tool.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker,mcp -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:mcp"
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && uv run arq app.queue.worker.WorkerSettings
scripts.dev:mcp: cd mcp && FASTMCP_SHOW_SERVER_BANNER=false uv run python -m server
